title: Simon 7.3.1: densities exist and are upper semicontinuous off spt ∂T; blow-up limits at support points are minimizing cones (registered obligation)
statement: Let ℓ ≤ k, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-submanifold with (N̄∖N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N. Then (1) there is Θ: ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ such that Θ^n(μ_T, x) = Θ(x) (limit of M_{B_ρ(x)}(T)/(ω_nρ^n) as ρ ↓ 0, with Θ(x) ≥ 0) for every x ∈ U ∖ spt ∂T, and Θ is upper semicontinuous on U ∖ spt ∂T; (2) for every x ∈ spt T ∖ spt ∂T and every sequence λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0, there are a subsequence λ_{j'} and an integer multiplicity C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}), minimizing in ℝ^{n+k}, with η_{x,λ_{j'}#}T ⇀ C in ℝ^{n+k}, μ_{η_{x,λ_{j'}#}T} → μ_C (for all representations), η_{0,λ#}C = C for all λ > 0, and Θ^n(μ_C, 0) = Θ^n(μ_T, x).
